main_idea: AfterQuery warmup lifted Nemotron 3 Ultra's GDPval score from 35.3 to 46.7.
ideas: Ultra has ~6x throughput of open models
summary: A clear bar chart is cluttered by three stat cards (two repeat the bars, one is a different claim), a blog tag and a footer URL; nothing important is missing.
defects: Stat card text overflows the card bottoms in the second and third cards
Footnote wraps and sits close to the URL
